Package neqsim.process.dynamics

Class DynamicCapabilityResolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.dynamics.DynamicCapabilityResolver
public final class DynamicCapabilityResolver extends Object
Transitional resolver for the dynamic capability of existing NeqSim process elements.

The long-term contract allows individual element types to override ProcessElementInterface.getDynamicCapability(). During the capability-audit campaign, this resolver provides conservative classifications for core models whose state semantics are already evident from their implementations. A class that overrides the standard transient boundary but has not yet been audited is deliberately returned as DynamicCapability.UNCLASSIFIED_DYNAMIC; it is never silently promoted to a professional dynamic model just because a runTransient method exists.

  • Field Details

    • UNCLASSIFIED_BUILT_IN_ADRS

      private static final Map<Class<?>,String> UNCLASSIFIED_BUILT_IN_ADRS
      Explicit ADR exemptions for built-in transient implementations that intentionally remain unclassified.

      Entries must map a declaring class to an existing repository-relative Markdown ADR. The source-inventory test rejects absent files. There are no exemptions after the WS6 audit closure.

    • resolveAuditedBuiltInClass

      static DynamicCapability resolveAuditedBuiltInClass(Class<?> type)
      Resolve one built-in class that declares the standard two-argument transient boundary.

      Classification is based on the class that declares the effective method, not merely the runtime subtype. A custom subclass that inherits an audited built-in implementation keeps that implementation's category. A subclass that overrides the method becomes DynamicCapability.UNCLASSIFIED_DYNAMIC until its own implementation is audited.

      Parameters:
      type - class declaring runTransient(double, UUID)
      Returns:
      audited capability, or null when the declaring class has no audit mapping

    • hasCustomTransientImplementation

      static boolean hasCustomTransientImplementation(ProcessElementInterface element)
      Detects whether a simulation object overrides the default algebraic transient boundary.

      This is a discovery mechanism only. An override proves that custom transient code exists; it does not prove that the implementation contains physically valid stored state, conserves the appropriate quantities, or has been quantitatively validated.

      Parameters:
      element - process element to inspect
      Returns:
      true if runTransient(double, UUID) is declared outside SimulationInterface
